open_items: ECB flapped between runs: degraded (cycle 1240) -> healthy (1241) -> gateway_issue (1242) -> healthy (1243, current). Cycle 1242's gateway_issue (gateway data failed, direct data succeeded) matches the exact scenario the previous run's open item asked to watch for. Root cause identified in code: tools/probing_tools.py _probe_via_csv calls SDMXProgressiveClient.fetch_data_probe() with no accept argument, so it never consults config.py:get_data_accept() (which knows ECB needs text/csv directly) and always triggers ECB's 406-then-retry-as-text/csv dance, making two sequential round trips per gateway-side probe where the monitor's own direct check (data_accept=text/csv in monitor/endpoints_config.py) makes one. This doubles ECB's exposure to ordinary transient latency on the gateway-only path. Not a data-correctness bug: tools/sdmx_tools.py (the real data-fetch tool) already calls get_data_accept and is unaffected; only the lightweight probe path skips it. Low urgency, self-resolved this cycle. See incidents.md cycle 1243 entry.
